decisions.S4: user approved S4g only; S4 unavailable
decisions.interpretation: user approved classification sensitivity, not proof of nonuse
decisions.sparse: user approved C grid and nonestimable single-class folds; no fold changes

methods.contribution: g_m * L2(P_m(normalized_x_m)); no shared bias; norm shares not causal or signed contributions
methods.aggregation: per task/fold/model/node-type first, equal fold means; no independence of repeated nodes
methods.removal: presence bit zero only in in-memory DGL local_scope; original graph/NPZ unchanged; gates recomputed
methods.interpretation_threshold: code_only prediction changes <0.001 AND zero nonSolidiFI positive class changes
methods.interpretation_limit: insensitivity to this intervention cannot prove nonuse; probability changes also reported
methods.C_selection: highest inner_val ROC AUC; ties smallest C; no refit on inner_val
methods.threshold_selection: redundancy=0.5; signal=max inner_val BF1, ties closest 0.5 then lower threshold
methods.prevalence: task-wide available STATIC rows, inclusive 1%-99%, as prescribed; transductive unsupervised bit filter disclosed
methods.population: redundancy=all available carrier nodes by frozen file split; signal=L-audit included nonSolidiFI original nodes with CODE+STATIC available
methods.groups: full schema subgroup and A-N parent both retained
methods.undefined: train/val empty or single-class not estimable; test single-class AUC/BA null, BF1 retained
methods.inference: descriptive only; no significance claims; probes fit logistic coefficients only, never HGT
methods.final_server: Separate future batch on adequate VRAM; local RTX3050 is current limitation
